name: report-problem
description: reportProblem saves what an assistant writes about a tool that misbehaved, for the user to send; the add-on sends nothing. A saveDraft call that fails (a draftId that names no draft) and a listFolders call that succeeds on the local account are followed by a bug report that names saveDraft, given as three answers (called, got, expected): the report is saved (saved true, sent false, one waiting), the result holds its link as a new GitHub issue with the add-on's record of calls, and the file commonpost-mcp-reports.json of the profile holds it with the versions, the date the add-on was installed, the error saveDraft had just returned and the record of that call (the names of its arguments, not their values, and its outcome); the mail address written in an answer is replaced. The same report a second time, a tool name that is not a tool of the server, a summary over 120 characters and a bug given as one text (as 0.27.0 took it) are refused. A suggestion that names listFolders is saved as the second report, with the record of the listFolders call and the kind of its account (none: local folders). Nothing is sent through SMTP. Not covered: the options page (its list, the prefilled GitHub issue, Send by email, Copy, Delete), which no MCP call reaches, the limit of 20 waiting reports, and the kinds of account other than the local one (imap, imap (gmail), pop3).
